Our missions

Four areas of aid, three programmes, two flagship actions, and one heart.

Our four areas of aid

Flip each card to see how it works and how you can help.

Food aid

Meals and groceries so no one goes to bed hungry.

Food aid

How it works

  • Grocery-store food drives several times a year.
  • Volunteers sort the donations.
  • Free food hampers for families, widows and students.
  • Soup and snacks during street outreach.

How you can help

  • Give non-perishable food at a drive.
  • Take a two-hour shift at a food drive.
  • Cook for an outreach night.
  • Fund a hamper: $40 = one hamper for a family [amount to confirm].

Clothing aid

Warm, dignified clothing, especially when the Québec winter arrives.

Clothing aid

How it works

  • We collect clean clothes in good condition.
  • Sorted by size and season.
  • Given free of charge to families and homeless people.
  • Winter bags (toque, mittens, socks) during street outreach.

How you can help

  • Donate coats, boots, toques and mittens.
  • Help sort one Saturday a month.
  • Knit toques and scarves!
  • Fund a winter bag: $25 [amount to confirm].

Academic support

Notebooks, homework help and workshops to move forward.

Academic support

How it works

  • School supplies for back-to-school.
  • Homework help from volunteers.
  • Workshops for parents (homework, budgeting, jobs).
  • Support for students going through hard times.

How you can help

  • Become a volunteer tutor.
  • Donate new school supplies.
  • Lead a workshop on your trade.
  • Fund a school kit: $30 [amount to confirm].

Material or financial help

Practical help when a family goes through a trial.

Material or financial help

How it works

  • Listening and a discreet assessment of the need.
  • One-time help: furniture, baby items, appliances.
  • Exceptional financial support, paid directly to the supplier.
  • Spiritual care, if the person wishes.

How you can help

  • Offer furniture or an item in good condition (on request).
  • Drive for a delivery.
  • Give monthly to the Heart Circle.
  • Pray for the families we walk with.

Our programmes

  1. Support for people in need

    Food, clothing, financial and spiritual help for people going through hard times.

  2. Training workshops

    Workshops, seminars, talks and awareness campaigns. The goal: helping people become self-reliant.

  3. Helping other charities

    Supporting other associations that carry social and humanitarian projects.

Our work in the field

Food drives

Several times a year we collect food at partner grocery stores.

Street outreach

On the streets of several Canadian cities, for homeless people, orphanages and students.
